tpl: Attack range expands and ATK +{0}. Immediately defeats enemies in range with HP below {1} of Logos's ATK, and deals Arts damage equal to the HP of the defeated unit to another random target. Unlimited duration

RES +{0}. Attacks now lock on to a target, dealing {1} ATK as Arts damage every 0.5s. When against the same target, gradually increases damage up to a maximum of 3x and gradually reduces its Movement Speed to up to 40% (max effect reached after 5s). The locked-on target and the effects are reset when the skill is interrupted, or when the target is defeated.
Attack range expands, ATK +{0}, and attacks strike {1} targets at once; enemy projectile speed in attack range is greatly reduced, and all projectiles are removed when the skill expires.
